Tidewake

A tile-laying survival game about steering junks along wake currents while leviathans stir. The mechanics follow a published game family; names, texts, board art and ship art here are original.

Audio

Every sound and the music in this game are public domain (CC0). With thanks to these creators:

  • Sound effects: Casino Audio, Impact Sounds, Interface Sounds, Music Jingles, RPG Audio, Sci-fi Sounds, UI Audio by Kenney (CC0)
  • Sound effects: “100 CC0 SFX #2” by rubberduck (OpenGameArt, CC0)
  • Sound effects: “40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX” by rubberduck (OpenGameArt, CC0)
  • Sound effects: “80 CC0 creature SFX” by rubberduck (OpenGameArt, CC0)
  • Music: “Eye of the Storm” by Joth (OpenGameArt, CC0)
  • Sound effects: “Mild Wind Background Noise” by Bashar3A (OpenGameArt, CC0)
  • Sound effects: “Ocean splash (cannon)” by thimras (OpenGameArt, CC0)
  • Music: “Seaside Village” by KarateStudios (OpenGameArt, CC0)

All sounds were trimmed, layered, loudness-normalised and converted to MP3 for this game. Names, card text and art are original.
